title: One angle predicts which probes the evader also fools
sub: Each dot is one of 50 probes in one of 3 seeds. Across: drop in AUROC that the formula predicts. Up: drop we measured after the evader trained against one probe. On the dashed line, prediction = measurement. r² = share of the variance in measured drops that the prediction explains, mean of 3 seeds; refit = AUROC of a fresh probe trained after the evasion.
